title: Sandy Marton - Camel by camel (original vocal mix)
description:
Fantastic banger music that's fit for progressive desert or pyramid levels.

This is a port of the vocal mix available as official song release.

I had an arrangement helping me do all the music accompany, but the melody sang by Sandy was re-created by ear.

I also made a music video with a custom smw level.

Props to musicalman for his samples of insanity!
